dialect.detail: Likely GnuCOBOL or similar open-source COBOL compiler; uses VSAM-style INDEXED file with FILE STATUS, UNSTRING/STRING verbs, RECORDING MODE F, no COMP-3, no EXEC SQL/CICS. Style consistent with GnuCOBOL student/educational use.

purpose.domain_detail: Unemployment insurance claims data processing - reads CSV files of unemployment claims broken down by age, ethnicity, industry, race, and gender, and loads them into an indexed (VSAM-style) database file.
purpose.summary: Reads five CSV input files containing unemployment claims statistics categorized by age, ethnicity, industry, race, and gender. Uses UNSTRING to parse CSV fields and STRING to reformat dates from MMDDYYYY to YYYYMMDD for proper key sorting. Writes records to an indexed file using WRITE for the first file and REWRITE for subsequent files.

notable_features: VSAM-style INDEXED file with RANDOM access and FILE STATUS
UNSTRING used to parse CSV input delimited by comma or space
STRING used to reformat date key from MMDDYYYY to YYYYMMDD
Five separate input CSV files merged into one indexed database
OPEN I-O after initial OPEN OUTPUT for subsequent REWRITE operations
88-level condition names for FILE STATUS values
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
